title: Pocket House | KEY.co
description_expanded: The management fees for your booking include access for all members of your party throughout your stay to utilize the facilities of the Seaside Swim and Tennis Club and Fitness Center. You will need to take the passes you will find in your arrival pack for access to each of these facilities each time you use them. There are towels provided at the pools and fitness center and you are asked not to take the guest towels in the bathrooms of the cottages to the pools or fitness center. An hourly use fee for the tennis courts is collected at the tennis pro shop. You may bring your own rackets and balls, or you may rent these at the pro shop. You may also check out basketball, badminton, croquet, shuffleboard, and volleyball accessories if you wish to use any of these facilities as well. Climb another set of stairs to reach the third floor, where two more beautifully appointed bedrooms await. The incredible king master suite is a haven of tranquility, complete with a chandelier, mounted plasma TV, and a spa-like private master bath. Indulge in the glass-enclosed spa shower with four rain shower heads, or unwind in the adjacent deep soaker tub with a mounted television. A second private laundry room is conveniently located off the king master suite. The spacious fourth bedroom offers a queen bed and a modern private bathroom with a glass-enclosed deep soaker tub and shower combination.

Features: Outdoor shower Outdoor grill Firepit Garden
